```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
```

# Load data

```{r}
load("../data/figure-data/desres_rberry.rda")
```

# PCA

# Volcano

```{r}
rber.desres %>%
  mutate(Tax.Sig=ifelse(padj < .05,TaxLev, NA),
        class.dum = ifelse(padj < 0.05, Taxa, NA)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2FoldChange,
             y=-log(padj),
             color=Tax.Sig,
             label=class.dum)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log(0.05),
             color="red") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-4,4),color="red") + 
  guides(color=guide_legend("Tax")) + 
  geom_text_repel( show.legend = FALSE) + 
  ggtitle("Black Raspberry vs. NMBA Control") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1",
                     na.value="gray50",
                     breaks=c("Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus")) 

ggsave("../figures/volcano_rberry-mics.png")
```

# LDA

```{r}
brb.sig <-
  rber.desres %>%
  filter(padj < .05) 


brb.sig %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2FoldChange,
             y=reorder(Taxa,log2FoldChange),
             fill=TaxLev)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  ggtitle("Effect Size BRB vs. NMBA - Significant Taxa") +
  ylab("Microbe Classification") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") 

ggsave("../figures/effecti-size_rberry-mics.svg",
height = 3, width = 4)
```
